invariants.rationale: The method's contract is to return a non-null List since it uses collect(Collectors.toList()) on a stream, which never returns null.
Input records is assumed to be non-null for stream operation to succeed without NPE.
All elements added to the result list are non-null, due to the .filter(Objects::nonNull) before collection.
Deduplication reduces or keeps the number of records, never increases it.
Parallelism is typically required to be at least 1 for parallel processing; negative or zero parallelism would not make sense in normal operation.
